explainer.summary: Counter-Strike 2 is Valve's competitive shooter, and it is the game behind the PGL Major Singapore 2026, the second CS2 Major of the year.
explainer.why_now: Stage 2 of the PGL Major Singapore began on November 28, so betting markets are listing the day's matches, such as Astralis vs Imperial and G2 vs Liquid.
background: The PGL Major Singapore runs from November 24 or 25 (sources differ) to December 13, 2026, with 32 teams and a prize pool of US$1,250,000. It is billed as the first CS2 Major in Southeast Asia.

Stage 1 was a 16-team Swiss event, and eight teams advanced. Stage 2 runs November 28 to December 1 with eight invited teams, including G2, THE ONE and Astralis, plus eight qualifiers, and eight teams advance to Stage 3.
Playoffs are December 10 to 13 at the Singapore Indoor Stadium, with best-of-three quarterfinals and semifinals and a best-of-five Grand Final.
